_readme: Hand-maintained in this repo; build_data.py never touches it. Holds what the upstream pipeline cannot: classFeatures = toggles for features the generator's every_class_feature.json does not carry (so the backend gate rejects them), same shape as class_feature_conditionals.json pools ({key: [conditional, ...]}, key = lowercase name without (Su)/(Ex)/(Sp)). passive = abilities that are known and deliberately NOT a per-attack toggle ({Name: why}); they leave the curation-gap list, stay out of Bespoke mode, and show as text-only reminder rows in Full mode.

snake feint.name: Snake Feint: Activation: combine a standard action spent moving (a move action if you can feint as a move action) with a feint; Effect: at 11th level, once per round declare your square and [[1]] adjacent square ([[2]] at 15th) as the origin of your attacks for flanking until your next turn

passive.Perfect Break: an improvised weapon that would be destroyed instead breaks into two improvised weapons one size smaller
passive.Brawler's Strike: unarmed strikes count as magic (5th), cold iron and silver (9th), an alignment (12th) and adamantine (17th) for overcoming DR
passive.Violent Ki: already automated by a permanent ki-damage buff; a toggle here would double-count it
